interpretation: Fixed historical resale rate for the same manufactured-order cohort. Includes calendar zero-demand days and only OrderDate before 2013-07-01. Known future due demand is subtracted once during planning. Manufactured rates, physical state, BOM and prices are unchanged. Master selling dates are retrospective source attributes; no claim of an untouched holdout or experimentally validated forecast accuracy is made.
no_history_policy: Explicit zero rate with NO_HISTORICAL_DEMAND provenance; no guessed demand.
